cisceNodes: c1_evs_006 (My need for food - types of food, healthy food)
mascotDescription: a friendly young chef with a white hat, apron, a wooden spoon, and a warm smile. Custom SVG, not an owl.
sceneDescription: kitchen scene with sky gradient through a window, a table with food items, a plate with healthy food, and a fruit basket
challengeTypes: identify: Which food gives us ENERGY to play? (Rice and roti vs Apple vs Milk)
identify: Which food helps us GROW tall and strong? (Milk and dal vs Chips vs Chocolate)
identify: Which food protects us from getting sick? (Fruits and vegetables vs Cold drink vs Chips)
sort: Drag foods to the right group (Energy-giving: rice, roti, potato, butter | Body-building: milk, dal, egg, paneer | Protective: orange, apple, banana, carrot, spinach)
identify: Is eating too much chips and chocolate good for us? (No, it is junk food vs Yes, it is healthy vs Only on Mondays)
identify: Why do we need food? (For energy, growth, and protection vs To play games vs To sleep)
sort: Drag foods to healthy or junk (Healthy: rice, milk, apple, carrot, dal | Junk: chips, chocolate, cold drink, candy)

sort: Drag food groups to what they do (Energy-giving: gives power to play | Body-building: helps grow tall and strong | Protective: guards from getting sick | Junk: tasty but too much sugar, salt, or oil)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. Teach: (1) Food is fuel for our body. (2) Three food groups — energy-giving (rice, roti, potato, butter), body-building (milk, dal, egg, paneer), protective (fruits and vegetables). (3) Junk food (chips, chocolate, cold drink, candy) is tasty but has too much sugar, salt, or oil — eat less. Misconceptions: "junk food is healthy because it tastes good" (junk food has too much sugar, salt, oil — eat less), "only milk makes us strong" (all body-building foods help — milk, dal, egg, paneer), "fruits are not important" (fruits and vegetables protect us from getting sick). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function FoodGame), NOT export default. Export interface FoodGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
